title: R1-Onevision: Advancing Generalized Multimodal Reasoning through Cross-Modal Formalization
authors_zh: Yi Yang, Xiaoxuan He, Hongkun Pan, Xiyan Jiang, Yan Deng, Xingtao Yang, Haoyu Lu, Dacheng Yin, Fengyun Rao, Minfeng Zhu, Bo Zhang, Wei Chen
paper_type_zh: 多模态推理数据构造与后训练论文
best_for_zh: 适合构建视觉思维链语料，或审计文本推理是否仍由图像证据支撑的读者。
one_line: R1-Onevision formalizes images for a language reasoner, filters the resulting multimodal CoT, and releases more than 155K demonstrations for visual reasoning SFT.
R1-Onevision 先把图像形式化为文本表示，再生成并过滤多模态思维链，发布超过 155K 条视觉推理示范用于 SFT。
why: It exposes a concrete image-to-description-to-reasoning record rather than treating multimodal reasoning supervision as an opaque final answer.
inclusion_reason: Releases 155K image-question-reasoning-answer demonstrations whose teacher, visual formalization, quality filter, and SFT consumer are explicit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal models can describe images or imitate fixed reasoning templates, yet they often fail when a solution requires repeatedly extracting visual evidence and connecting it to deep textual reasoning. A fluent chain can therefore be wrong because its initial image description omitted a relation, while final-answer supervision hides that grounding failure.

R1-Onevision converts each image into a formal textual representation, asks a language reasoner to produce a step-by-step solution, revisits the image through role-playing, and removes inaccurate or inconsistent steps. Its direct output is a public collection of more than 155K image-question-reasoning-answer demonstrations used for multimodal SFT before a separate RL stage.

L4 facts: primary source https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10615, first posted March 2025; no peer-reviewed venue confirmed; the decision boundary is whether a formalized and filtered visual CoT becomes an SFT target; atlas object is a multimodal demonstration with visual description, trace, answer, and filter evidence; collected for Track 01.

多模态模型可以描述图像或模仿固定推理模板，但在需要反复提取视觉证据并把它连接到深层文本推理时仍容易失败。因此，一条流畅的推理链可能只因最初图像描述漏掉某个关系而得到错误结论，而只监督最终答案又会掩盖这种落地失败。

R1-Onevision 先把每张图像转换成形式化文本表示，再让语言推理模型生成逐步解答，通过角色扮演过程重新查看图像，并删除不准确或不一致的步骤。它直接产出一个公开集合，包含超过 155K 条图像、问题、推理链和答案示范，先用于多模态 SFT，再进入独立的 RL 阶段。

L4 事实：主来源为 https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10615，首次发布于 2025 年 3 月；未确认同行评审 venue；判定边界是形式化且经过过滤的视觉思维链是否进入 SFT；图谱对象是含视觉描述、轨迹、答案与过滤证据的多模态示范；本次按 Track 01 收录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
R1-Onevision makes the interface between vision and language reasoning an explicit training object: formalize the image, let a strong text reasoner write a solution, ground the solution again through image-aware role-playing, and filter the serialized trace before SFT. Compared with fixed four-stage templates such as LLaVA-CoT, it changes the target from a rigid reasoning format to a revisitable image-grounded trace; final-answer and format rules remain a separate RL feedback contract. The initial category is instruction, demonstration, and rationale data because the released trace is directly consumed as an SFT target rather than only as a reward.

Google Scholar citations: 371（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=R1-Onevision%3A+Advancing+Generalized+Multimodal+Reasoning+through+Cross-Modal+Formalization&author=Yi+Yang&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Dataset name: R1-Onevision. Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Fancy-MLLM/R1-onevision. Scale: more than 155K samples. Record form: image, question, formal visual description, conversation-style reasoning response, and final answer; the public Hugging Face release exposes tabular image-text records. File/storage format: Hugging Face-hosted Parquet/Arrow access. Domains/languages: primarily English science, mathematics, general-scene, and document/chart/screen reasoning tasks. Construction and filtering: GPT-4o describes and filters, DeepSeek-R1 reasons from the formalized view, and role-playing reconnects the trace to the image. License/access constraints: public access is governed by the Hugging Face platform terms, but a dataset-specific content license was not confirmed and platform access does not establish redistribution rights. Intended use: multimodal reasoning SFT and distillation.

R1-Onevision 把视觉与语言推理的接口变成显式训练对象：先形式化图像，让强文本推理模型写出解答，再通过能重新查看图像的角色扮演过程把解答落回视觉证据，并在 SFT 前过滤序列化轨迹。与 LLaVA-CoT 等固定四阶段模板相比，它把目标从刚性推理格式改为可回看图像的落地轨迹；最终答案与格式规则则属于独立的 RL 反馈契约。初始分类选择 instruction、demonstration 与 rationale 数据，是因为发布的完整轨迹直接作为 SFT 目标消费，而不只是充当奖励。

Google Scholar 引用数：371（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=R1-Onevision%3A+Advancing+Generalized+Multimodal+Reasoning+through+Cross-Modal+Formalization&author=Yi+Yang&hl=en）

开源数据：有。数据集名称：R1-Onevision。官方地址：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Fancy-MLLM/R1-onevision。规模：超过 155K 条样本。记录形式：图像、问题、形式化视觉描述、对话式推理回复和最终答案；公开 Hugging Face 发布页提供表格化图文记录。文件与存储格式：可通过 Hugging Face 托管的 Parquet/Arrow 形式访问。领域与语言：以英文为主的科学、数学、一般场景以及文档、图表和屏幕推理任务。构造与过滤：GPT-4o 负责描述和过滤，DeepSeek-R1 基于形式化视图推理，角色扮演过程把轨迹重新连接到图像。许可与访问约束：公开访问受 Hugging Face 平台条款约束，但未确认数据集专用内容许可，平台访问本身也不授予再分发权。预期用途：多模态推理 SFT 与蒸馏。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Prepare and formalize visual tasks. Input: images and questions from science, mathematics, general scenes, and document/chart/screen domains. Operation: normalize each task and ask GPT-4o for a dense, formal visual description that exposes objects, relations, values, and layout needed by a text reasoner. Output: an image-question-description record. Check: the paper does not report a deterministic description validator.
  2. Generate textual reasoning. Input: the formal description and question. Operation: DeepSeek-R1 writes a detailed solution and final answer from the textual representation. Output: a candidate cross-modal CoT. Check: generation parameters and rollout count are not disclosed.
  3. Reground and filter the trace. Input: the candidate trace plus the original image. Operation: role-playing prompts let the multimodal pipeline revisit the image, while GPT-4o removes inaccurate, irrelevant, or inconsistent reasoning steps. Output: a retained image-question-trace-answer demonstration. Check: reject judged defects; the filtering prompt, threshold, and false-positive rate remain unknown.
  4. Assemble and consume the SFT collection. Input: retained records from all four domain groups. Operation: combine more than 155K records and fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL for one epoch with batch size 128 and learning rate 1e-5. Output: a model with standardized think/answer behavior. Check: compare the base, SFT, and SFT+RL variants on fixed visual reasoning benchmarks.
  5. Add rule-based RL and evaluate. Input: the SFT model and a 10K CLEVR subset. Operation: GRPO rewards regex-extracted final-answer accuracy or IoU and requires correctly ordered <think> tags; evaluate on MathVision, MathVerse, MathVista, WeMath, and R1-Onevision-Bench. Output: R1-Onevision models and benchmark scores. Check: final scores validate the combined SFT+RL recipe, not every generated step.

Reproducibility: pin the image sources, formalization and filtering prompts, GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 versions, dataset snapshot, Qwen2.5-VL checkpoint, GRPO code, CLEVR subset, reward regexes, and evaluation extractor. Generation/filtering compute, sampling parameters, exact source proportions, and judge error rates are not disclosed.

1. 准备并形式化视觉任务。 输入：来自科学、数学、一般场景以及文档、图表和屏幕领域的图像与问题。操作：规范化每个任务，再让 GPT-4o 生成稠密的形式化视觉描述，显式写出文本推理模型所需的对象、关系、数值和布局。输出：图像、问题与描述记录。检查：论文没有报告确定性的描述验证器。
  2. 生成文本推理。 输入：形式化描述与问题。操作：DeepSeek-R1 根据文本表示写出详细解答和最终答案。输出：候选跨模态思维链。检查：论文未披露生成参数和 rollout 数量。
  3. 重新落地并过滤轨迹。 输入：候选轨迹和原始图像。操作：角色扮演提示让多模态流程重新查看图像，同时由 GPT-4o 删除不准确、不相关或不一致的推理步骤。输出：保留的图像、问题、轨迹与答案示范。检查：拒绝被 judge 判为有缺陷的记录；过滤提示、阈值与假阳性率仍未知。
  4. 组装并消费 SFT 集合。 输入：四个领域组中保留的记录。操作：合并超过 155K 条记录，以 batch size 128、learning rate 1e-5 训练 Qwen2.5-VL 一个 epoch。输出：具备规范化思考与答案格式的模型。检查：在固定视觉推理 benchmark 上比较 base、SFT 与 SFT+RL 版本。
  5. 加入规则 RL 并评测。 输入：SFT 模型和 10K 条 CLEVR 子集。操作：GRPO 按正则提取后的最终答案准确性或 IoU 给奖励，并要求 <think> 标签顺序正确；随后在 MathVision、MathVerse、MathVista、WeMath 与 R1-Onevision-Bench 上评测。输出：R1-Onevision 模型与 benchmark 分数。检查：最终分数验证的是 SFT+RL 组合配方，而不是每个生成步骤。

复现要求：固定图像来源、形式化与过滤提示、GPT-4o 和 DeepSeek-R1 版本、数据集快照、Qwen2.5-VL checkpoint、GRPO 代码、CLEVR 子集、奖励正则与评测答案提取器。论文未披露生成和过滤计算量、采样参数、精确来源比例以及 judge 错误率。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
1. Training-strategy ablation. Under the same Qwen2.5-VL-7B lineage, the base scores 25.4 on MathVision, 43.6 on MathVerse, and 38.2 on MathVerse Vision Only; SFT on R1-Onevision data changes these to 26.3, 43.4, and 39.7, while SFT+RL reaches 29.9, 46.4, and 40.0 (Table 4). This supports a small direct SFT benefit and a larger combined post-training gain, but it cannot attribute the full SFT+RL difference to the 155K demonstrations alone.
  2. Model-size transfer. On the 3B base, R1-Onevision training raises MathVision from 21.7 to 23.7, MathVerse from 34.7 to 38.6, and Vision Only from 31.2 to 35.5 (Table 6). The direction is consistent across two model sizes, but both share the Qwen2.5-VL family and the same evaluation surface.

1. 训练策略消融。 在同一 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 谱系下，base 在 MathVision、MathVerse 和 MathVerse Vision Only 上分别为 25.4、43.6 和 38.2；使用 R1-Onevision 数据做 SFT 后分别变为 26.3、43.4 和 39.7，而 SFT+RL 达到 29.9、46.4 和 40.0（表 4）。这组结果支持 SFT 带来较小的直接收益，也支持组合后训练获得更大增益，但不能把 SFT+RL 的全部差异单独归因于 155K 条示范。
  2. 模型规模迁移。 在 3B base 上，R1-Onevision 训练把 MathVision 从 21.7 提高到 23.7、MathVerse 从 34.7 提高到 38.6、Vision Only 从 31.2 提高到 35.5（表 6）。两个模型规模上的方向一致，但它们都属于 Qwen2.5-VL 家族并共享同一评测表面。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Fixed-template multimodal CoT systems such as LLaVA-CoT prescribe a small set of reasoning stages, while direct imitation collections attach curated answers without exposing how textual reasoning reconnects to pixels. R1-Onevision changes the training object to a trace built through image formalization, strong language reasoning, image-aware role-playing, and post-generation quality filtering. This makes the cross-modal handoff and its judge auditable before SFT. Dense captioning, teacher distillation, SFT, and GRPO are not individually new; the contribution is their use to construct and consume a large revisitable visual-reasoning record.

LLaVA-CoT 等固定模板多模态思维链系统预先规定少量推理阶段，而直接模仿型数据集只附上整理后的答案，没有暴露文本推理如何重新连接到像素。R1-Onevision 把训练对象改为经过图像形式化、强语言推理、图像感知角色扮演和生成后质量过滤得到的轨迹。这样，跨模态交接过程及其 judge 在 SFT 前就成为可审计对象。稠密描述、teacher 蒸馏、SFT 与 GRPO 本身都不是新组件；真正的贡献是用它们构造并消费大规模、可回看图像的视觉推理记录。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. The pipeline depends on GPT-4o both to formalize visual evidence and to remove flawed steps; a missed object or judge false positive can preserve a plausible but ungrounded trace. Before reuse, sample records against the original image and report errors separately for description, reasoning, and answer.
  2. The 155K mixture does not fully disclose source proportions, per-source licenses, decontamination, or a dataset-specific redistribution license. Pin the release snapshot and complete a source-level rights and benchmark-overlap audit before mixing it into another public corpus.
  3. Table 4 combines SFT data with later CLEVR RL, and the reported gains remain within one base-model family. Reuse studies should hold the base, image resolution, training budget, and evaluation extractor fixed and include a data-only control.

1. 该流程同时依赖 GPT-4o 形式化视觉证据和删除错误步骤；如果它漏掉对象或产生 judge 假阳性，就可能保留看似合理却没有图像支撑的轨迹。复用前应对照原始图像抽样，并分别报告描述、推理和答案错误。
  2. 155K 混合数据没有完整披露来源比例、逐来源许可、去污染过程或数据集专属的再分发许可。将其混入另一个公开语料前，应固定发布快照，并完成来源级权利与 benchmark 重叠审计。
  3. 表 4 把 SFT 数据与后续 CLEVR RL 组合起来，且已报告增益仍限于同一个 base-model 家族。复用实验应固定 base、图像分辨率、训练预算和评测答案提取器，并加入只改变数据的对照。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. A visual-CoT dataset builder can reuse the image formalization, text-reasoning, image-regrounding, and judge-filter stages on an owned image-question pool. The output is an SFT collection with descriptions, traces, and answers; success requires human image-grounding audits plus a matched data-only training control.
  2. A curator comparing multimodal reasoning corpora can treat the formal description and judge result as lineage fields, then measure how often a trace cites unsupported visual facts. This produces an auditable grounding report rather than another model score.
  3. Do not use the acceptance rule unchanged when images require specialist perception or when source redistribution rights are unclear; replace GPT-4o-only screening with domain review and finish a source-level license audit first.

1. 视觉思维链数据构建者可以在自有图像问题池上复用“图像形式化、文本推理、重新落回图像、judge 过滤”四个阶段。输出是含描述、轨迹和答案的 SFT 集合；成功检查需要人工图像落地审计，以及训练预算匹配的纯数据对照。
  2. 比较多模态推理语料的 curator 可以把形式化描述与 judge 结果当作 lineage 字段，再测量轨迹引用无支撑视觉事实的频率。这样得到的是可审计的落地报告，而不只是另一个模型分数。
  3. 当图像需要专业感知能力或来源再分发权不清楚时，不应原样采用该接受规则；必须先用领域审阅替代只依赖 GPT-4o 的筛查，并完成来源级许可审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: The paper targets the gap between visual perception and long textual reasoning by making the cross-modal description and resulting trace part of the training record.
  • Method handle: Formalize the image, generate with DeepSeek-R1, revisit the image through role-playing, filter with GPT-4o, then run SFT and rule-based RL.
  • Data handle: R1-Onevision publicly exposes more than 155K demonstrations across four domain groups; the record joins image, question, description, reasoning, and answer, while dataset-specific redistribution rights remain unknown.
  • Evidence anchor: On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, base/SFT/SFT+RL MathVision scores are 25.4/26.3/29.9; the combined gain is not a data-only attribution.
  • Reuse decision: Use it to prototype image-grounded CoT supervision, but first audit description omissions, judge false positives, source rights, and benchmark overlap.

• 定位： 论文针对视觉感知与长文本推理之间的断层，把跨模态描述及其生成轨迹一起纳入训练记录。
  • 方法抓手： 先形式化图像，再由 DeepSeek-R1 生成，通过角色扮演重新查看图像，用 GPT-4o 过滤，最后执行 SFT 和规则 RL。
  • 数据抓手： R1-Onevision 公开超过 155K 条、覆盖四个领域组的示范；记录连接图像、问题、描述、推理和答案，但数据集专属再分发权仍未知。
  • 证据锚点： 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，base、SFT、SFT+RL 的 MathVision 分数依次为 25.4、26.3、29.9；组合增益不能解释为纯数据归因。
  • 复用决定： 它适合原型化图像落地的思维链监督，但必须先审计描述遗漏、judge 假阳性、来源权利与 benchmark 重叠。

GPT-4o filtering is a judgment contract whose false-positive rate and prompt sensitivity are not reported.
SFT and RL gains are combined in the final model, so final scores do not isolate every data-construction choice.
不完整或不正确的形式视觉描述可将语言推理器导向连贯但视觉上无依据的痕迹。

SFT 与 RL 增益在最终模型中合并，故最终分数不能隔离每一数据构建选择。
